latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of agentic-mcp-server-builder.
- Enables scaffolding of MCP server projects with tool schema definitions and baseline contract checks.
- Generates starter server layouts and summarizes tool contracts from structured lists.
- Provides scripts and guides for creating and validating MCP-ready server structures.
- Emphasizes explicit tool boundaries and clear input/output schemas.
